newsitem.title: USA: Craig Consumer sees Q1 loss of $1.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Craig Consumer sees Q1 loss of $1.2 mln.

text.p: Craig Consumer Electronics Inc said Wednesday it would report a first quarter loss of $1.2 million.

It also said it had reached a tentative settlement of class-action claims against the company. Terms of the settlement will be disclosed when presented to the applicable court in accordance with appropriate procedures, it said.
Craig said the settlement should enable it to overcome a major obstacle to obtaining new inventory and receivable financing to advance its business interests.
